title: Exact projection of decorated runs
statement: Let $P$ be a finite Turing machine over an alphabet $A$, let $l$ be a natural number, choose a work-tape index $h$ of $P$, a finite data-state set $D$ with initial state $d_0$, and any visit function of the specified type. Suppose every transition of $P$ emits no output symbol. For every input word $x$ and time $t\in\mathbb N$, projecting the decorated machine's configuration after $t$ steps from its initial configuration on $x$ onto the schedule yields exactly the configuration of $P$ after $t$ steps from its initial configuration on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $D$ is finite and has decidable equality
$P$ is a finite Turing machine over $A$
The visit function has the stated type
Every transition of $P$ emits no output symbol
replaced:
Let $P$ be a machine over an alphabet $A$ whose transition table never emits an
output symbol, decorated by any data transducer. For every input word $x$ and every
time $t \in \mathbb{N}$, the schedule projection of the decorated machine's
configuration after $t$ steps from its initial configuration on $x$ equals the
configuration of $P$ after $t$ steps from its initial configuration on $x$.
